CODEX · BOLUOPAI

Install in Codex

Choose a Skill and give its installation request to Codex. It fetches the complete plugin from the GitHub marketplace, without manual ZIP downloads or extraction.

What would you like to use?

After copying, paste and send in a Codex chat. Start a new chat after installation.

Make Yinyang your own

Installation supplies the formation method, philosophical documents, and diagrams. Ask the model to develop a private version from the goals and material you choose to share. Keep personal content in your own private source, outside replaceable plugin caches.

Use terminal commands

Each plugin includes the complete Skill and supporting resources. Configure external tools and accounts as needed; installation does not provision services.

View the selected Skill source · Installation, updates, and private versions

This is an independent GitHub plugin marketplace. Yinyang uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the other Skills use MIT. Installation does not depend on a public directory listing.
